observations.heading: P119 milestone roll-up
observations.body: P119 closes v3.1 by rolling phase chronicle contexts into a milestone-level artifact.

claims.heading: Forward-only default
claims.body: Milestone-level chronicle context preserves grounded phase evidence without requiring the v3.0 retrospective by default.

evidence_verdicts.heading: Schema fixture verdict
evidence_verdicts.body: Golden milestone fixture validates against chronicle.schema.json.

decisions.heading: Roadmap miner scope
decisions.body: Roadmap mining is emitted as JSON and keeps fog score optional when the cockpit-sidecar scorer is unavailable.

denominators.heading: scope_excluded
denominators.body: Roadmap miner emits JSON only; milestone HTML synthesis is out of scope.

denominators.heading: carve_outs_not_fired

denominators.heading: alternatives_rejected

denominators.heading: assumptions_made

denominators.heading: gates_skipped

synthesis.heading: Capstone synthesis
